svg.aria-label: \begin{aligned}z=2\cdot3+1=7,\quad h=\max(0,z)=7,\quad\widehat y=2h=14,\quad L=\tfrac12(14-4)^2=50\\[5pt]\frac{\partial L}{\partial w}=(\widehat y-y)\cdot2\cdot1\cdot x=10\cdot2\cdot1\cdot3=60\end{aligned}
